Accelerant.Description: Stun nearby enemies with strong accelerant. Increases all fire damage dealt.
Accelerant.Name: Accelerant

Overheat.Description: Gives the player an aura of fire damage while granting some incoming damage reduction.
Overheat.Name: Overheat

World On Fire.Description: Blast nearby foes with a burst of fire, and follow that up with a barrage of fireballs against any enemy who dares approach. Over time, these fireballs burn hotter as they consume more energy.
World On Fire.Name: World On Fire

Undertow.Description: Become a water trap and drown unsuspecting enemies.
Undertow.Name: Undertow

Bounce.Description: A deployable launchpad that can be attached to any surface. Use on enemies, squad members, or as a personal mobility tool
Bounce.Name: Bounce

Tesla.Description: Launches a grenade that holds an electrical charge, zapping enemies that come within range.
Tesla.Name: Tesla

Radial Blast.Description: Rhino punches the ground, dealing high damage to enemies in a small radius.
Radial Blast.Name: Radial Blast

Blink.Description: The Itzal Archwing teleports a short distance, dropping all enemy target locks.
Blink.Name: Blink

Dive Bomb.Description: Zephyr nose dives towards the ground creating an explosion on contact.
Dive Bomb.Name: Dive Bomb

Vortex.Description: Creates a whirling mass of energy that violently attracts nearby enemies, crushing their atoms into a tiny spec of matter.
Vortex.Name: Vortex

Devour.Description: Hold power to trap target in quicksand and draw them in for devouring; this steals health and ultimately creates a friendly Sand Shadow.
Devour.Name: Devour

Super Jump.Description: Excalibur launches into the air, jumping 3 times higher than normal.
Super Jump.Name: Super Jump

Iron Jab.Description: Explode the Iron Staff to its true length, knocking down anything in its path.
Iron Jab.Name: Iron Jab

Rift Walk.Description: Pass over into the rift plane.
Rift Walk.Name: Rift Walk

Glory on High.Description: Soar with destructive power. Use alternate-fire to detonate Judgments, causing an explosion of Jade Light. Enemies inside the Light's Judgment radius empower the explosion.
Glory on High.Name: Glory on High

Plunder.Description: Plunder Armor from nearby enemies and increase <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Damage on your Abilities and weapons. Enemies affected by <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status offer a greater increase.
Plunder.Name: Plunder

Infernalis.Description:
Manifest an aura of flames inflicting <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage and Status Effect on nearby enemies.

Tap Dodge while airborne to take flight as a flaming meteor of destruction.
Infernalis.Name: Infernalis

Crush.Description: Magnetize the bones of nearby enemies, causing them to collapse upon themselves.
Crush.Name: Crush

Atomi-Barrage.Description: Target oncoming enemies with a barrage of micro missiles that inflict damage and leave targets vulnerable to further damage.
Atomi-Barrage.Name: Atomi-Barrage

Minelayer.Description:
Control the battelfield with masterful mines. Vauban's Tether-Flechette orb immobilizes and draws in enemies while launching deadly nails in all directions.

HOLD to launch a Vector-Overdrive pad that accelerates foes and allies alike in the pad's direction, increasing ally Movement Speed and Weapon Damage.
Minelayer.Name: Minelayer

Warding Halo.Description: Create a protective ring of fire, that also stuns and damages enemies who get too close.
Warding Halo.Name: Warding Halo

Photon Strike.Description: Drop a targeting beacon that calls in a devastating laser artillery strike. Deals doubled damage to enemies with Overguard.
Photon Strike.Name: Photon Strike

Desecrate.Description: Forces fallen enemies around you to drop additional loot.
Desecrate.Name: Desecrate

Resonator.Description: Launches a rollerball that charms foes to follow it. Combines with the Mallet to create a roving ball of sonic destruction.
Resonator.Name: Resonator

Artemis Bow.Description: Summon a mighty bow and unleash a volley of devastating arrows.
Artemis Bow.Name: Artemis Bow

Danse Macabre.Description: Erupt with a multitude of Eidolon energy beams and sweep a circle of death around Revenant. The beams will modify their Damage Type to target select defenses, while incoming damage is redirected back into the beams. Hold fire to boost Status Effects and Damage, at the cost of increased energy consumption. Thralls killed by this ability leave overshield pickups.
Danse Macabre.Name: Danse Macabre

Rift Surge.Description: Surges nearby Rift-bound enemies with Rift energy. When killed the Rift Surge is transferred to a nearby enemy outside the rift. Surged enemies that leave the Rift perform a radial Banish.
Rift Surge.Name: Rift Surge

Cataclysm.Description: A violent blast of Void energy tears open a pocket of rift plane which can sustain itself for a short period before collapsing in another lethal blast.
Cataclysm.Name: Cataclysm

Temporal Anchor.Description:
Drops a Temporal Anchor which, after a short duration, Protea rewinds to trigger a temporal implosion. Implosion damage increases based on damage dealt between anchor drop and rewind. Everything lost or expended in that time is returned.
Dying while Anchor is active rewinds Protea to the anchor, saving her. Protea is knocked down and the anchor vanishes.
Temporal Anchor.Name: Temporal Anchor

Fireball.Description: Release a fiery projectile that ignites enemies on contact.
Fireball.Name: Fireball

Mend & Maim.Description: In Night-Form, allies' Shields are replenished with each nearby enemy killed. In Day-Form, enemies are inflicted with <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effect. Deactivate while in Night-Form to restore Health and Shields for Equinox and allies. Deactivate while in Day-Form to cast a wave of slashing force.
Mend & Maim.Name: Mend & Maim

Magnetize.Description:
(TAP) Enclose a target in a magnetic field that ensnares nearby enemies and deals damage over time. The field pulls Polarize Shards that orbited Mag and shrapnel into the deadly mix.
(HOLD) Mag surrounds herself in a magnetic field that absorbs ranged attacks and reflects damage back in a destructive cone.
Magnetize.Name: Magnetize

Aegis Storm.Description: Take the skies and rain Balefire rockets down on the enemy. Nearby enemies are blasted into the air where they will create an Energy Orb every few seconds. When shields run out the enemies are smashed into the ground.
Aegis Storm.Name: Aegis Storm

Coil Horizon.Description: Throw forward a Gyratory Sphere that will implode after a few seconds or can be manually triggered.
Coil Horizon.Name: Coil Horizon

Light's Sanctuary.Description:
Sirius creates a well of light that heals and revives allies, while reducing incoming damage. The well slowly grows in size and power.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Event Horizon.
Light's Sanctuary.Name: Light's Sanctuary

Razor Gyre.Description: Dash forward in a spinning vortex of death. Struck enemies are inflicted with <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau Status Effect, making them more vulnerable to all other status effects. For each enemy hit, recover a portion of the energy cost, as well as health and shields. Enemies lifted by Sentient Wrath take increased damage.
Razor Gyre.Name: Razor Gyre

Molt.Description: Shedding her skin like a snake, Saryn leaves a decoy behind to draw fire from enemies.
Molt.Name: Molt

Blade Storm.Description: Project fierce Shadow Clones of Ash upon groups of distant enemies. Join the fray using Teleport. The Shadow Clones can be upgraded with mods.
Blade Storm.Name: Blade Storm

Shuriken.Description: Launches a spinning blade of pain, dealing high damage and impaling enemies to walls.
Shuriken.Name: Shuriken

Blessing.Description: Restore the health and shields of allies within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range while reducing the damage they take from enemies.
Blessing.Name: Blessing

Serene Storm.Description: With his Restraint eroded, Baruuk commands the Desert Wind to deliver powerful radial strikes with his fists and feet. Each moment commanding the storm restores his Restraint.
Serene Storm.Name: Serene Storm

Sporespring.Description: Unleash a chaotic ballistic mushroom that seeks enemies and bounces explosively off whatever it touches. Contact with any of Nokko's mushrooms invigorates them, doubling their pulse rate.
Sporespring.Name: Sporespring

Shroud of Dynar.Description:
(TAP) Dynar shrouds Voruna with invisibility and accelerates her speed. Invisibility ends when Voruna attacks. For a short time after invisibility ends, melee attacks have increased Critical Damage, Status Chance, Critical Chance and inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effects. Melee kill an enemy during this time to extend the melee buff once per cast.

(HOLD) Dynar guards Voruna, increasing her Parkour Velocity.
Shroud of Dynar.Name: Shroud of Dynar

Crucible Blast.Description: Release a beam from Qorvex's Crucible Core. Each enemy struck suffers <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect. Enemies affected by <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status explode in a chain reaction.
Crucible Blast.Name: Crucible Blast

Chyrinka Pillar.Description: Summon a Chyrinka Pillar that slows enemies. It pulses <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect.
Chyrinka Pillar.Name: Chyrinka Pillar

Cathode Grace.Description: Gain a brief burst of increased Critical Chance and Energy Regen, with each kill extending duration of Cathode Grace. Casting is on a cooldown.
Cathode Grace.Name: Cathode Grace

Peacemaker.Description: With intense focus, Mesa draws her Regulator pistols, shooting down her foes in rapid succession.
Peacemaker.Name: Peacemaker

Breach Surge.Description:
Open a dimensional breach to overwhelm nearby enemies and cause them to release aggressive Surge sparks when damaged.
Wisp may also target a Reservoir to teleport to it and double the range of the surge.
Breach Surge.Name: Breach Surge

Defy.Description:
Wukong and his twin become invulnerable and defy enemies to attack. All damage is captured, stored, and dealt back in a single furious strike of Wukong's staff.
Bonus Armor is then granted relative to the damage captured.
Defy.Name: Defy

Absorb.Description: Nyx draws in and contains the damage dealt to her and the damage confused enemies deal to each other then converts it into a devastating radial blast. Following the blast, she enters a brief invulnerable state and gains a Weapon Damage boost proportional to the absorbed damage.
Absorb.Name: Absorb

Miasma.Description: Release a poisonous miasma that deals <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage to enemies in range. Foes afflicted by spores are more susceptible to the mist.
Miasma.Name: Miasma

Divine Spears.Description: Impale nearby enemies on spears that erupt from the below. Activate again to slam surviving enemies back into the ground.
Divine Spears.Name: Divine Spears

Rhino Charge.Description: Rhino charges towards a target, clobbering any in his path and goring his victim.
Rhino Charge.Name: Rhino Charge

Necraweb.Description: Hurl a canister of graviton fluids to create a wide mire that will significantly slow enemies traveling across it. Alternatively, the canister can be shot in mid-air to create a fiery conflagration.
Necraweb.Name: Necraweb

Grasp of Lohk.Description: Void Tendrils steal weapons from nearby enemies to use as your own floating, auto-targeting armament. Damage output increases based on enemy level. The number of weapons grabbed also determines the damage multiplier for The Lost: Deny's Void beam.
Grasp of Lohk.Name: Grasp of Lohk

Aquablades.Description: Tear through foes with a trio of orbiting aquatic blades.
Aquablades.Name: Aquablades

Disarray.Description: Drops flare beacons confusing incoming guided missiles.
Disarray.Name: Disarray

Nourish.Description: Regenerate health as Grendel absorbs nourishment from enemies in his gut. While he digests, enemies that attack or are attacked by Grendel suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage and energy sources provide more energy. These buffs extend to squad mates.
Nourish.Name: Nourish

Metamorphosis.Description: Switch forms, temporarily gaining bonus Shields and Armor in Night-Form, or bonus Damage and Speed in Day-Form.
Metamorphosis.Name: Metamorphosis

Blazing Chakram.Description: Hurl a flaming ring that sets enemies ablaze making them vulnerable to any damage. Flaming enemies drop Restorative Orbs on death. Charge to amplify the power of the ring, and reactivate to instantly travel to the ring's location.
Blazing Chakram.Name: Blazing Chakram

Summon Kaithe.Description: Summon your Kaithe. Cast again to dismount. Dismounting can also be performed by melee attacking and can occur when taking damage from enemies.
Summon Kaithe.Name: Summon Kaithe

Kinetic Plating.Description: Generate armor plating that converts a portion of absorbed Kinetic Damage (Physical, <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat, <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold, and <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast) into Energy. Also protects Gauss from being staggered or knocked down. Damage Resistance is relative to the battery level.
Kinetic Plating.Name: Kinetic Plating

Sonic Boom.Description: Banshee emits a sonic shockwave that pushes targets in range with enough force to incapacitate or kill attackers.
Sonic Boom.Name: Sonic Boom

Celestial Clash.Description:
Sirius & Orion take to the skies in a cosmic duel. Each attack consumes a Constellation Star to inflict colossal collateral <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast damage. Match the star's color to the Warframes color to gain increased Critical Chance.

|LEFT_ATTACK| Sirius attacks
|RIGHT_ATTACK| Orion attacks

Generate Constellation Stars by using abilities. No more than two stars of the same color can be added in a row.
Celestial Clash.Name: Celestial Clash

Perspicacity.Description: Your next hack will be automatic.
Perspicacity.Name: Perspicacity

Cosmic Crush.Description: Forms a miniature black hole that sucks in all nearby objects before rupturing in a massive shock wave.
Cosmic Crush.Name: Cosmic Crush

Mallet.Description: Rhythmically beats damage into nearby enemies and draws their fire. Damage inflicted on the Mallet increases its lethality.
Mallet.Name: Mallet

Seeking Talons.Description: Charge to expand the targeting area, release to send Garuda's talons careening toward each target in area. Surviving enemies are prone to <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
Seeking Talons.Name: Seeking Talons

Atomi-Boost.Description: Kick it into overdrive with a massive burst of speed.
Atomi-Boost.Name: Atomi-Boost

Penance.Description: Sacrifice Shields to boost Reload Speed, and Fire Rate while converting damage inflicted on enemies into health for Harrow and nearby allies.
Penance.Name: Penance

Bloodletting.Description: Garuda sacrifices her health to generate energy and clear Status Effects.
Bloodletting.Name: Bloodletting

Shatter Shield.Description: Envelops Mesa in a barrier of energy, reflecting back incoming bullet damage.
Shatter Shield.Name: Shatter Shield

Ophanim Eyes.Description: Jade summons an accusatory gaze that slows nearby enemies and dissolves their Shields and Armor. When the gaze falls upon allies, they can be revived from a distance.
Ophanim Eyes.Name: Ophanim Eyes

Xata's Whisper.Description: Wield <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>Void Damage for all attacks from equipped weapons when activated.
Xata's Whisper.Name: Xata's Whisper

Bastille.Description:
Erect a containment field to capture enemies and suspend them in stasis, stripping their armor and granting it to Vauban and any allies within Bastille's field.

HOLD to collapse all Bastilles into a single damaging vortex.
Bastille.Name: Bastille

Overdrive.Description:
Drive loudspeakers into epic distortion to create a damaging wave of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage while also increasing vulnerability to Critical Chance. 

Backbeat Timing: Doubles Critical Chance. Increases the Duration and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage of Ripper's Wail when it deals damage.
Overdrive.Name: Overdrive

Hall of Mirrors.Description: Mirage creates an entourage of doppelgangers to confuse and distract the enemy.
Hall of Mirrors.Name: Hall of Mirrors

Hoof Stomp.Description: Kaithe aggressively stomps into the ground, even from flight, creating a shockwave to stagger and damage all enemies in the area.
Hoof Stomp.Name: Hoof Stomp

Rip Line.Description: Valkyr hurls forth a hook and pulls herself to whatever it hits. If it hits an enemy, nearby foes are pulled in as she unleashes a coordinated Melee attack.
Rip Line.Name: Rip Line

Self Portrait.Description: Draw an ink effigy to absorb the damage dealt to Follie and allies. Below, a pool of ink spreads Inkblot. Kill enemies inside the pool to grow Follie's effigy and its ink puddle.
Self Portrait.Name: Self Portrait

Freeze.Description: A frigid energy blast that freezes targets in their tracks.
Freeze.Name: Freeze

Embrace.Description: Ghostly hands pull enemies into a flailing mass.
Embrace.Name: Embrace

Final Verse.Description:
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. TRIUMPH: Two Light Verses cast in succession invigorate allies with a buff that increases Health and grants Overguard. Kills and assists briefly regenerate Overguard.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. TRAGEDY: Two Dark Verses cast in succession attack enemies. Damage Over Time from Slash, Heat and Toxin Status Effects accumulates in a single blast.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. WORDWARDEN: A Light Verse followed by a Dark Verse supports allies with copies of Noctua. Noctua copies synchronize their attacks with their designated ally's attacks.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. PAGEFLIGHT: A Dark Verse followed by a Light Verse summons Paragrimms that swoop at enemies, making them vulnerable to Status Chance and Status Damage, as well as drawing enemy attacks away from allies.
Final Verse.Name: Final Verse

Elemental Ward.Description: Depending on Chroma's elemental alignment, an offensive area-of-effect is created. Chroma and its nearby allies are imbued with defensive energy.
Elemental Ward.Name: Elemental Ward

Soul Punch.Description: A blow so powerful, it turns the enemy's very soul into a deadly projectile, damaging all in its path. Enemies that survive the blow are Marked for Harvest and become one of Nekros' Shadows of the Dead if killed while marked.
Soul Punch.Name: Soul Punch

Noctua.Description: Open Noctua, Dante's Exalted Tome, and unleash a tale of woe upon his enemies.
Noctua.Name: Noctua

Effigy.Description: Chroma turns his pelt into a massive sentry that strengthens nearby allies and engulfs enemies in elemental attacks.
Effigy.Name: Effigy

Phoenix Blaze.Description: Wreathes the Railjack in fire, increasing Turret Damage and Speed.
Phoenix Blaze.Name: Phoenix Blaze

Shattered Lash.Description: Lash out with stream of shattered glass, or hold for an arcing strike. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Shattered Lash.
Shattered Lash.Name: Shattered Lash

Collective Curse.Description: Kullervo sends forth a curse that binds enemies. When a cursed enemy takes damage from him, every other cursed enemy also suffers a portion of that damage.
Collective Curse.Name: Collective Curse

Grave Spirit.Description: Supercharge Dagath's weapons with extra Critical Damage. The effects are doubled on Doomed enemies. Escape fatal blows by briefly assuming a spectral form.
Grave Spirit.Name: Grave Spirit

Amp.Description: Draws power from the decibel level of sound in the area and uses it to amplify a damage buff for Octavia and her allies. It also doubles the damage and range of nearby Mallets.
Amp.Name: Amp

Light's Judgment.Description: Create a well of light that heals allies and hurts enemies. Those who enter the well will be highlighted by Judgments.
Light's Judgment.Name: Light's Judgment

Atomi-Bomb.Description: Jump off the Atomicycle and send it racing forward where it will explode on impact.
Atomi-Bomb.Name: Atomi-Bomb

Scarab Swarm.Description: Summon a Scarab Swarm to attack enemies with guaranteed <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status. Damage scales with Inaros' Health. Enemies killed while immersed in the swarm summon a Swarm Kavat that fights alongside Inaros and guides the scarabs to other enemies.
Scarab Swarm.Name: Scarab Swarm

Tentacle Swarm.Description: Summon a creature from the depths. Its watery tentacles emerge from nearby surfaces to wreak havoc.
Tentacle Swarm.Name: Tentacle Swarm

Pillage.Description: Pillage a percentage of Shields and Armor of nearby enemies to replenish Hildryn's own Shields and Overshields. Also removes Status Effects from Hildryn and her allies.
Pillage.Name: Pillage

Brightbonnet.Description: Release a rejuvenating mushroom that emits a radial pulse, giving Nokko and his allies' <ENERGY> Energy and applying a buff to Ability Strength that lasts for a short time.
Brightbonnet.Name: Brightbonnet

Enthrall.Description: Convert a target into a zealous thrall. Thralls turn on their allies and enthrall through damage. On death, they disintegrate into a damaging pillar of energy. The thrall horde remains under Revenants spell until this ability runs out.
Enthrall.Name: Enthrall

Brimstone.Description: Uriel and his demons create a growing ring of flaming brimstone. Charge the ability by utilizing demon abilities. Damage inflicted increases with each consecutive hit.
Brimstone.Name: Brimstone

Fusion Strike.Description: Converge three streams of raw energy upon a single point, causing a massive explosion. The streams strip armor and shields, and each enemy struck detonates on stream convergence. Summoned Conculysts can wield their own mini Fusion Strikes.
Fusion Strike.Name: Fusion Strike

Haven.Description: Create a shield aura around allies. Enemies that approach shielded allies will take damage.
Haven.Name: Haven

Guiding Hand.Description: Cast to release a guiding light that will lead you to the next main objective, or other side objectives in the area. Guiding Hand will prioritize Conservation targets once a Conservation encounter has started.
Guiding Hand.Name: Guiding Hand

Decoy.Description: Loki deploys a holographic copy of himself that draws enemy fire. The decoy gains health and shield based on enemies nearby.
Decoy.Name: Decoy

Lantern.Description: Create a swarm of razorflies that transform an enemy into an irresistible floating beacon, attracting witless comrades before exploding on command.
Lantern.Name: Lantern

Desolate Hands.Description: Summon a bevy of orbiting daggers to seek out enemy guns, destroying them with a small explosion. Combine with Elude to double the range.
Desolate Hands.Name: Desolate Hands

Dark Verse.Description: Dante's composition draws blood from nearby enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage upon them.
Dark Verse.Name: Dark Verse

Storm Shroud.Description: Swathe the Necramech in a powerful electrical field that greatly enhances survivability in close combat. Enemies that strike the shroud will suffer for their impudence.
Storm Shroud.Name: Storm Shroud

Core Vent.Description: Vents out the Archwing's propulsion core, confusing enemy projectiles and causing them to detonate.
Core Vent.Name: Core Vent

Link.Description: Any damage taken while Link is active will be channeled to a nearby enemy.
Link.Name: Link

Plein Air.Description: Tie nearby enemies to floating balloons that douse them with Inkblot. Pop the balloons to send them crashing to the ground, splashing damage on nearby enemies.
Plein Air.Name: Plein Air

Covenant.Description: Protect nearby allies with an energy force that absorbs all damage and converts it to a Critical Chance bonus for all those under the Covenant. Headshots are amplified even further.
Covenant.Name: Covenant

Pull.Description: Mag stuns enemies as she manifests a magnetic vortex. The vortex pulls in Polarize Shards and stunned enemies to place them directly in front of her.
Pull.Name: Pull

The Vast Untime.Description: Temporarily shed the outer pieces of Xaku in a destructive blast, then stalk the battlefield in a new, swifter skeletal form. Enemies damaged by the body shrapnel are rendered weaker to <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>Void Damage. Xaku's other active abilities' duration is frozen in time and resumes once The Vast Untime expires.
The Vast Untime.Name: The Vast Untime

Gravemines.Description: Launch a pattern of charged mines all around you. Each mine detonates in a violent blast when touched, damaging enemies in a three-meter radius.
Gravemines.Name: Gravemines

Prowl.Description: Become invisible and steal loot from unsuspecting enemies or take out prey with deadly headshots.
Prowl.Name: Prowl

Snow Globe.Description: Frost deep freezes any vapor and moisture in the area, creating a protective sphere with brief invulnerability to boost its strength.
Snow Globe.Name: Snow Globe

Rally Point.Description: Draw enemy attention to Styanax. His resolve uplifts him and nearby allies, regenerating the squad's energy over time. Styanax and his allies also regenerate shields for every kill assist they contribute.
Rally Point.Name: Rally Point

Disometric Guard.Description: Guard yourself and nearby allies against Status Effects. Each time Qorvex kills or assists in killing an enemy affected by <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status, the number of Status Effects Disometric Guard can prevent increases.
Disometric Guard.Name: Disometric Guard

Radial Howl.Description: Let out ferocious howl that stuns nearby enemies and causes Sentients to shed any built up resistances.
Radial Howl.Name: Radial Howl

Merulina.Description: Summon Merulina, a rideable creature of the waves, and the inspiration for K-Driving. Merulina protects Yareli by absorbing a large portion of incoming damage.
Merulina.Name: Merulina

Petrify.Description: Atlas' hardened gaze will fossilize foes increasing the damage they take, heal Rumblers, and create Petrified Bulwarks. When shattered, petrified enemies drop healing Rubble for Atlas.
Petrify.Name: Petrify

Sentient Wrath.Description: Smash the ground sending out a radial wave of destruction. Those not killed by the initial blast are helplessly raised into the air, where they take amplified damage for a short time.
Sentient Wrath.Name: Sentient Wrath

Iron Skin.Description: Rhino hardens his skin, insulating himself from all damage and gaining Overguard.
Iron Skin.Name: Iron Skin

Sea Snares.Description:
Form five water globules that seek out enemies and expand on contact, simultaneously damaging and immobilizing their victims.
Enemies hit by the globules take increased damage from all sources.
Sea Snares.Name: Sea Snares

Renewal.Description: Generates a protective aura that grants bonus Armor to Oberon and his allies and restores allies' Health over time. Healing is doubled while within the radius of Hallowed Ground.
Renewal.Name: Renewal

Resupply.Description:
Throw two Elemental Ammo Packs that instantly refill the active weapon's magazine, while granting the weapon an additional instance of the selected Elemental Damage and Status Effect. Reload clears the effect. Sniper Rifles gain extra damage.

Hold the ability to select the Elemental Damage type.
Resupply.Name: Resupply

Feast.Description: Swallow enemies whole and store them in Grendel's gut. Hold to vomit out stored enemies, covering them in toxic bile.
Feast.Name: Feast

Psychic Bolts.Description: Nyx unleashes a volley of psychic bolts that track and strike nearby enemies with telekinetic precision. When enemies are slain, additional bolts scatter to new targets. Striking foes weakens their defenses and transfers a portion to Nyx.
Psychic Bolts.Name: Psychic Bolts

Benevolent Decoy.Description: Creates beacons that draw enemy fire, converting the damage into healing pulses.
Benevolent Decoy.Name: Benevolent Decoy

Molecular Prime.Description: Primes all enemies in an expanding radius with volatile antimatter. Press the ability to slow down enemy movement, hold the ability to speed them up.
Molecular Prime.Name: Molecular Prime

Dread Mirror.Description: Rip the life force from an enemy and use it as a shield that captures damage, this kills significantly weakened enemies instantly. Charge to channel the captured damage into an explosive projectile.
Dread Mirror.Name: Dread Mirror

Punishment.Description: Absorb incoming damage and cast it back at enemies in a barrage of energy projectiles.
Punishment.Name: Punishment

Exalted Solo.Description:
Once a charge has been built up on the Backbeat metronome, set Lizzie aflame and torch enemies with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat. While aimed, Lizzie blasts enemies with thunderous elemental sound waves, use ability controls to change the Elemental Damage type.

Backbeat Timing: No Energy consumed.
Exalted Solo.Name: Exalted Solo

Dispensary.Description: Deploys a device that generates 3 pickups after a short delay: empowered health orb, universal ammo pack and energy orb.
Dispensary.Name: Dispensary

Demonium.Description: Uriel rips out the souls of his demons, draining their health, and sends them in search of new victims. Souls explode on contact with an enemy, rendering it vulnerable to Damage.
Demonium.Name: Demonium

Maiden's Kiss.Description: Raise Bonewidow's shield to block incoming forward damage. While active, bash enemies with a Maiden's Kiss.
Maiden's Kiss.Name: Maiden's Kiss

Firing Line.Description: Sweep surrounding enemies into the line of fire and suspend them in air with a force beam.
Firing Line.Name: Firing Line

Reap.Description: Sevagoth's Shadow flies outward ravaging enemies in his path. Survivors are damaged by Death's Harvest over time. The souls of the dead fill the Death Well.
Reap.Name: Reap

Reunite.Description: Sevagoth and his Shadow become one.
Reunite.Name: Reunite

Inferno.Description: Command a flaming comet to crash down in front of Ember, engulfing enemies with a fire that can spread through their ranks.
Inferno.Name: Inferno

Coronal Ejection.Description:
Hurl Sirius' Jade Light infused scythe, dealing <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage while collecting any pickups in its path.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Gravitic Slash.
Coronal Ejection.Name: Coronal Ejection

Gravitic Slash.Description:
Repel enemies with Orion's sinister scythe, dealing <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage and Status Effect while reducing shields and armor.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Coronal Ejection.
Gravitic Slash.Name: Gravitic Slash

Death's Harvest.Description: Inflict nearby enemies with a harrowing condition.
Death's Harvest.Name: Death's Harvest

Sound Quake.Description: Channeling all of her acoustic energy into the environment, Banshee uses ultrasonic reverberations to violently shake the ground.
Sound Quake.Name: Sound Quake

Radial Disarm.Description: Lets forth a wave of energy, disrupting the projectile weapons of enemies in range and forcing them to revert to melee combat.
Radial Disarm.Name: Radial Disarm

Expedite Suffering.Description: Condense all Slash and Toxin Status Effects into a single damage instance.
Expedite Suffering.Name: Expedite Suffering

Sonar.Description: Using acoustic location, Banshee's Sonar power finds and tracks enemies, and exposes critical weak spots to everyone in your squad.
Sonar.Name: Sonar

Smoke Screen (Duviri).Description: Cast to throw a smoke grenade that releases smoke in a 10 meter radius, turning Drifter and teammates invisible while inside of it.
Smoke Screen (Duviri).Name: Smoke Screen

Grenade Fan.Description:
Throw out grenades in an arc.

(TAP) SHRAPNEL VORTEX
Creates a slashing, staggering swirl of shrapnel.

(HOLD) SHIELD SATELLITES
Protea reconfigures Grenades to work as overcharging shield generators, protecting her, her allies and companions. When Shields break, a Satellite is destroyed to double minimum Shield Gate invincibility time.
Grenade Fan.Name: Grenade Fan

Speed.Description: Embody an electric current. Volt and his allies receive a brief movement speed boost and a reload speed buff.
Speed.Name: Speed

Discharge.Description: Volt discharges the electricity that courses through him. The shockwave paralyzes and damages nearby enemies. Enemies on the edge of the shockwave are stunned.
Discharge.Name: Discharge

Ballistic Battery.Description: When activated, this power stores damage caused by guns. When triggered again, that damage is channelled through the next gunshot.
Ballistic Battery.Name: Ballistic Battery

Balefire.Description: Charge and launch devastating bolts of electricity.
Balefire.Name: Balefire

Neutralize.Description: Summon the Neutralizer, Cyte-09's exalted Sniper Rifle. Bullets ricochet off Weak Points to seek out other nearby Weak Points. Alt fire lobs a <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold grenade that completely freezes enemies.
Neutralize.Name: Neutralize

Energized Munitions.Description: Imbue your weapons with ammo efficiency.
Energized Munitions.Name: Energized Munitions

Pulverize.Description: Grendel curls into a ball. He heals over time as he rolls, knocking over anyone in his path. Jumping slams Grendel into the ground and generates a damaging shockwave.
Pulverize.Name: Pulverize

Marked For Death.Description: Stun an enemy; a portion of the next damage you deal to it will be dealt to all enemies around it.
Marked For Death.Name: Marked For Death

Kumihimo.Description:
Weave the threads of destiny. Enemies who touch the threads suffer a random Elemental Status Effect.

A roll of triple sixes creates threads that inflict one of every Elemental Status Effect.
Kumihimo.Name: Kumihimo

Omamori.Description:
Surround yourself with Omamori Charms, each with a chance to have enemy attacks heal you instead of damage you. The number of charms is determined by Koumei's dice roll.

A roll of triple sixes grants invulnerability for the duration of your Omamori Charms.
Omamori.Name: Omamori

Regurgitate.Description: Violently puke out a bile soaked enemy from Grendel's gut, turning the consumed into a toxic projectile. Nearby enemies are slowed and have their armor dissolved by the bile.
Regurgitate.Name: Regurgitate

Mass Vitrify.Description: Create an expanding ring of molten glass that slowly crystallizes enemies who enter. When the expansion is complete, the ring hardens to block weapons fire. The ring draws extra strength from the health and shields of crystallized enemies. Use Shattered Lash to smash the ring and send razor-sharp glass flying.
Mass Vitrify.Name: Mass Vitrify

Parasitic Link.Description: Bind to a target with parasitic link. When cast on an ally, both the host and Nidus have their Ability Strength and Weapon Damage increased. Linked enemies take some of the damage inflicted on Nidus.
Parasitic Link.Name: Parasitic Link

Quiver.Description: Cycle through and shoot one of four tactical arrows. Cloak creates a stationary bubble that cloaks Ivara and allies. Dashwire creates a traversable zipline. Noise emits a high-pitched sound that attracts enemies to it. Sleep temporarily puts nearby enemies into a deep slumber.
Quiver.Name: Quiver

Desiccation.Description: Blast enemies with a wave of cursed sand that blinds them and steals their health.
Desiccation.Name: Desiccation

Final Stand.Description: Exude might and valor. Rise into the air and throw a barrage of Axios Javelins. The javelins deal damage to nearby enemies wherever they land. Direct hits to enemies deal greater damage.
Final Stand.Name: Final Stand

Celestial Twin.Description:
Shedding part of himself, Wukong creates a twin to fight by his side. Attack at range and the twin will melee, pull a blade and the twin will lay down covering fire.
Use again to command the twin to attack a target with increased damage.
Celestial Twin.Name: Celestial Twin

Astral Shell.Description:
Envelop Orion in an Astral Shell. Upon taking damage the shell becomes a decoy that draws fire until it's destroyed.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Jade Stars.
Astral Shell.Name: Astral Shell

Hallowed Ground.Description: Sanctifies the ground around Oberon, inflicting <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage to all enemies within the radius. Also grants protection against Status Effects for Oberon and his allies.
Hallowed Ground.Name: Hallowed Ground

Fractured Blast.Description: Slash and stagger enemies with a crystal blast that inflicts <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status. Enemies afflicted with this Status Effect have an increased chance of dropping Health and Energy Orbs.
Fractured Blast.Name: Fractured Blast

Wyrd Scythes.Description: Wyrd Scythes surround Dagath and seek out nearby enemies. Those struck are slowed and suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect. The scythes also spread Doom and extend its duration.
Wyrd Scythes.Name: Wyrd Scythes

Wrathful Advance.Description:
(TAP) Kullervo charges a Heavy Attack, then teleports to his target and strikes. His rage-filled focus temporarily increases his Melee Critical Chance.
(HOLD) Teleport to any marked location.
Wrathful Advance.Name: Wrathful Advance

Energy Vampire.Description: Allies will gain energy over time when enemies are marked with Energy Vampire.
Energy Vampire.Name: Energy Vampire

Bunraku.Description:
Wield your foe's fate threads like the strings of marionettes. Koumei's dice determine how many Status Effects foes in front of Koumei will suffer.

A roll of triple sixes causes further Status Effects over time and extends Bunraku to enemies behind Koumei.
Bunraku.Name: Bunraku

Penumbra.Description: Activates a cloaking field that hides the Warframe and any nearby allies who remain stationary.
Penumbra.Name: Penumbra

Recompense.Description: Kullervo surrounds himself with daggers. Each dagger that strikes an enemy restores his health, but each dagger that misses an enemy strikes Kullervo, dealing a bit of damage. When Kullervo has max Health, he receives Overguard from struck enemies.
Recompense.Name: Recompense

Arcsphere.Description: Launch a Gyratory Sphere that will deal high damage on impact and periodically deal electrical shocks to nearby enemies. Hit multiple enemies at once with the initial launch to enhance damage.
Arcsphere.Name: Arcsphere

Wil-O-Wisp.Description: Cast forward a spectral image of Wisp to confuse and distract enemies. Reactivate to travel to its position. Hold to have the image travel faster and teleport to its position on release.
Wil-O-Wisp.Name: Wil-O-Wisp

Switch Teleport.Description: Loki instantaneously swaps positions with a target, confusing the enemy.
Switch Teleport.Name: Switch Teleport

Whipclaw.Description: Send enemies reeling with a deafening whipcrack. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Whipclaw.
Whipclaw.Name: Whipclaw

Axios Javelin.Description: Throw an Axios Javelin. When the javelin impales an enemy against a wall, surrounding enemies are pulled into the area and suffer a burst of damage.
Axios Javelin.Name: Axios Javelin

Reckoning.Description: Lifts enemies into the air and then hurls them down with conviction, removing their Armor. Enemies hit by this ability will grant Oberon additional Armor and have a chance to spawn a <HEALTH>Health Orb when they die.
Reckoning.Name: Reckoning

Eclipse.Description:
(TAP) Temporarily reduce the damage Mirage takes from enemies.
(HOLD) Temporarily increase Mirage's weapon damage.
Eclipse.Name: Eclipse

Venari.Description: Command Venari to focus on a target. Hold to cycle between Attack, Protect, and Heal postures. If Venari is killed, use this ability to revive her instantly.
Venari.Name: Venari

Webbed Embrace.Description: Oraxia throws a creeping web to ensnare her prey. Enemies caught within the widening radius are trapped inside a cocoon that increases their Damage Vulnerability.
Webbed Embrace.Name: Webbed Embrace

Watchful Swarm.Description: Tiny drones orbit the Warframe or an ally, and intercept enemy fire.
Watchful Swarm.Name: Watchful Swarm

Catalyze.Description:
Catalyst Probes erupt from Lavos and douse combatants in a fiery gel. Damage is doubled for each element afflicting an enemy.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat.
Catalyze.Name: Catalyze

Warhead.Description: Launches a plodding missile capable of unleashing a massive explosion.
Warhead.Name: Warhead

Repel.Description: The Warframe emits a massive pulse of energy, stunning nearby enemies and sending them flying.
Repel.Name: Repel

Reservoirs.Description: Choose and summon a Reservoir filled with Motes that attach to and aid Wisp and her allies. Haste Mote grants increased movement and attack speed. Vitality Mote increases maximum health and heals over time. Shock Mote stuns nearby enemies.
Reservoirs.Name: Reservoirs

Primal Fury.Description: Summon the iron staff and unleash fury.
Primal Fury.Name: Primal Fury

Warding Grace.Description: Renders the Warframe and nearby allies immune to Status Effects, while slowing nearby enemies.
Warding Grace.Name: Warding Grace

Mind Control.Description: Nyx seizes control of a target's mind, compelling them to fight for the Tenno cause. Controlled enemies have increased <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status Chance. When Nyx shoots them, they also have an increased Damage Multiplier.
Mind Control.Name: Mind Control

Voracious Metastasis.Description: Consume Energy to heal yourself and grant matching Energy to each ally.
Voracious Metastasis.Name: Voracious Metastasis

Exalted Shadow.Description: When the Death Well fills, Sevagoth's Shadow form is ready to be released. Tear the enemy asunder with a collection of melee-focused abilities.
Exalted Shadow.Name: Exalted Shadow

Virulence.Description: Rupture the ground with a damaging fungal growth that steals energy from each enemy it strikes. For every five enemies hit, the Infestation mutates, multiplying its destructive force.
Virulence.Name: Virulence

Vial Rush.Description:
Dash forward, crashing through enemies and leaving an icy trail of broken vials.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold.
Vial Rush.Name: Vial Rush

Vex Armor.Description: Chroma fortifies squad Armor when his Shields are damaged or he kills an enemy with a melee weapon. He increases squad Weapon Damage when he loses Health or he kills an enemy with a ranged weapon, double the effect on weak point kills.
Vex Armor.Name: Vex Armor

Prismatic Gem.Description: Deploy a gem that shoots prismatic beams. The gem targets enemies that are taking weapon damage from Citrine and her allies. Its beams inflict Heat, Cold, Toxin, and Electricity Status Effects. Status Chance and Status Duration increase for nearby allies.
Prismatic Gem.Name: Prismatic Gem

Vengeful Rush.Description: All damage taken is transformed into Energy, while abilities gain enhanced Range, Duration and Power. Affects the Warframe and nearby allies.
Vengeful Rush.Name: Vengeful Rush

Well of Life.Description: Create a well of life on an enemy who will absorb Status Effect damage intended for nearby allies. Allies gain additional Health when they attack the target. If allies die, enemies in the well of life die in their stead.
Well of Life.Name: Well of Life

Ulfrun's Descent.Description:
(TAP) Voruna drops to all fours and prepares 5 brutal charges that lock onto enemies. Ulfrun, the most powerful wolf, leads the attack as Voruna dashes toward her target. The pack deals increased damage to targets and nearby enemies that are inflicted by Status Effects. Lethal attacks double the damage of Voruna's remaining charges.

(HOLD) Ulfrun guards Voruna. If Voruna falls during this time, Ulfrun dies in her place.
Ulfrun's Descent.Name: Ulfrun's Descent

Blood Altar.Description: Impale an enemy on an altar of talons and siphon health for Garuda and her allies.
Blood Altar.Name: Blood Altar

Turbulence.Description: Creates a wind shield around Zephyr, redirecting all incoming projectiles.
Turbulence.Name: Turbulence

Tribute.Description: Cycle through and extract one of the four Buffs when cast on an enemy. Thorns reduces incoming damage. Dust degrades enemy accuracy. Full Moon increases companion damage. Entangle slows enemies within range.
Tribute.Name: Tribute

Paralysis.Description: Unleash a damaging blast, slowing its victims while increasing their Melee Damage Vulnerability.
Paralysis.Name: Paralysis

Transmutation Probe.Description:
Launch a probe that converts Health and Energy Orbs into Universal Orbs that provide both, and ammo pickups into Universal Ammo Pickups. The probe shocks enemies in close proximity. Each electrocuted foe reduces other ability cooldowns by 1.5s.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity.
Transmutation Probe.Name: Transmutation Probe

Blaze Artillery.Description: Deploys an artillery unit to blast plasma charges at enemies it faces. Each enemy hit increases the power of subsequent plasma attacks.
Blaze Artillery.Name: Blaze Artillery

Redline.Description: Push Gauss' battery beyond the redline, supercharging his Abilities and setting Fire Rate, Attack Speed, Reload Speed, and Casting Speed into overdrive. When past the redline, bolts of arcing electricity dance periodically from Gauss, exploding en masse when the ability is deactivated.
Redline.Name: Redline

Lycath's Hunt.Description:
(TAP) Lycath hunts to sustain the pack. Enemies killed by melee attacks drop health orbs and enemies killed by headshots drop energy orbs. Increase the duration of Lycath's hunt by killing enemies affected by 5 or more Status Effects.

(HOLD) Lycath guards Voruna with increased Heavy Attack efficiency.
Lycath's Hunt.Name: Lycath's Hunt

Thermal Sunder.Description: Siphon kinetic energy from the area, charging the battery and inflicting <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status on nearby enemies. Hold reverses the process, draining the battery and inflicting <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Status on nearby enemies.
Thermal Sunder.Name: Thermal Sunder

Cloud Walker.Description: Evaporate into a cloud of mist and float through the battlefield, dazing any enemies encountered, while healing Wukong and his twin.
Cloud Walker.Name: Cloud Walker

Tornado.Description: Create deadly tornadoes that seek out and engulf enemies. Tornadoes deal the elemental Damage Type they absorb the most. Shoot engulfed enemies to inflict extra damage. Hold for stationary tornadoes or tap for wandering ones.
Tornado.Name: Tornado

Tidal Surge.Description: Crash through enemies in a ferocious wall of water.
Tidal Surge.Name: Tidal Surge

Thurible.Description: Channel Harrow's energy into the Thurible to generate a buff. Once finished, kill enemies to bestow nearby allies with bursts of energy. The more energy channeled the greater the reward for each kill. Headshots produce extra energy.
Thurible.Name: Thurible

Thumper.Description: Creates a localized storm of punishing explosions.
Thumper.Name: Thumper

Golden Instinct.Description: Send out a short-lived Void Spark that is drawn toward the nearest Medallion, Ayatan Sculpture, rare crate, unscanned Kuria or unscanned Fragment.
Golden Instinct.Name: Golden Instinct

Transference Surge.Description: Summon your Warframe and its weapons onto Duviri for a brief time when Transference Surge is fully charged.
Transference Surge.Name: Transference Surge

Elude.Description: Dodge all incoming projectiles, but only while not attacking. Use again to deactivate this ability.
Elude.Name: Elude

Scarab Shell.Description: Activate to form Armor by draining Inaros' Health. Activate again to stop the formation early. The protective layer reduces incoming Damage and absorbs Status Effects.
Scarab Shell.Name: Scarab Shell

Tesla Nervos.Description: Deploy a roller drone that attaches itself to enemies and delivers bursts of arcing <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR> Electricity Damage to anything in the immediate area.
Tesla Nervos.Name: Tesla Nervos

Terrify.Description: Cast fear into the hearts of nearby enemies, causing them to run away in terror.
Terrify.Name: Terrify

Tempest Barrage.Description: Summon a tempest to rain down upon a target area.
Tempest Barrage.Name: Tempest Barrage

Teleport.Description: Teleport to a target and perform a Finisher. If the finisher kills the target, Ash regains a portion of the energy spent.
Teleport.Name: Teleport

Teleport (Stalker).Description: Teleport to a target and perform a finisher. If the finisher kills the target, Stalker regains a portion of the energy spent.
Teleport (Stalker).Name: Teleport (Stalker)

Jade Stars.Description:
Sirius conjures Jade Light motes that slowly regenerate over time. Attacking enemies launches the motes, dealing <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage and Status Effect.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Astral Shell.
Jade Stars.Name: Jade Stars

Tectonics.Description: Summon a Bulwark rock-wall, activate again to send the rocks crashing toward the enemy. Bulwarks attacked by enemies release an area-of-effect Slash powered by the Health it has lost.
Tectonics.Name: Tectonics

Hysteria.Description: Valkyr bares her deadly claws, unleashing devastating attacks that also heal her. Valkyr becomes immune to Status Effects and her Armor bonus from Warcry is multiplied while using the claws.
Hysteria.Name: Hysteria

Tail Wind.Description: Hold while airborne to hover Zephyr with reduced movement. From the air, tap to dash forward, or aim down to dive bomb enemies below.
Tail Wind.Name: Tail Wind

Reroot.Description: Revert to Sprodling form, spawning orbs that heal Nokko and grant a speed boost. While in this state, Nokko is untargetable and heals gradually.
Reroot.Name: Reroot

Widow's Brood.Description: Oraxia launches a barrage of stinging darts in front of her that applies <DT_POISON_COLOR> Toxin Status Effect. Poisoned enemies spawn Scuttlers when killed.
Widow's Brood.Name: Widow's Brood

Strangledome.Description: Weave a dome of living chain that ensnares and strangles any enemy within, and any foolish enough to approach. Foes outside the trap will try to hasten their comrade's deaths by shooting them. Crack Whipclaw on the dome to further damage any trapped enemies.
Strangledome.Name: Strangledome

Storm of Ukko.Description: The Void answers Kullervo's invocation with a storm of daggers that rain down upon his enemies.
Storm of Ukko.Name: Storm of Ukko

Stinkbrain.Description: Throw a mushroom that periodically sheds poisonous spores, inflicting <DT_VIRAL_COLOR> Viral Damage and Status Effect upon nearby enemies while also lulling them to sleep.
Stinkbrain.Name: Stinkbrain

Mach Rush.Description: Burst into a hyper-sprint bowling over enemies and charging the battery. Crashing into solid objects generates a powerful shockwave. Hold to rush continuously.
Mach Rush.Name: Mach Rush

Antimatter Drop.Description: Launch a large particle of charged antimatter that will detonate on contact. Direct the particle by aiming, shoot it to charge it further. Deals <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect.
Antimatter Drop.Name: Antimatter Drop

Steadfast Dismount.Description: While riding a Kaithe, press 4 to dismount and gain 150 [[Overguard]]. 150 second cooldown between uses.
Steadfast Dismount.Name: Steadfast Dismount

Stasis.Description: Freezes Rift-bound enemies. While active, enemy projectiles are arrested in mid-air, resuming its trajectory when stasis ends.
Stasis.Name: Stasis

Fire Blast.Description: Slam the ground to create a wave of incinerating plasma that knocks back enemies and strips their armor.
Fire Blast.Name: Fire Blast

Splinter Storm.Description: Gara's armor splinters into a maelstrom of shattered glass. Allies who contact the cloud are fortified against damage.
Splinter Storm.Name: Splinter Storm

Spellbind.Description: Enemies fumble their weapons as they are whisked into the air. Nearby allies become immune to Status Effects. Hold the ability to cast the immunity onto Titania.
Spellbind.Name: Spellbind

Reave.Description: Dash through enemies as a wall of sentient energy, leeching shields and health from any encountered, enhanced for thralls.
Reave.Name: Reave

Spectrorage.Description: Trap enemies in a carousel of mirrors, forcing them to attack visions of their true selves. Destroyed mirrors damage their attackers, as does the collapse of the carousel.
Spectrorage.Name: Spectrorage

Silken Stride.Description:
Unfurl Oraxia's spider legs and go on the prowl. Oraxia is immune to Status Effects and has increased Maximum Health. Ranged Weapons are imbued with <DT_POISON_COLOR> Toxin Damage. Killing enemies causes them to burst with <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin.

Silken Thread: Tap Dodge to leap to a targeted surface.
Silken Stride.Name: Silken Stride

Navigator.Description: Assume control of any projectile launched by Ivara and guide it to the target.
Navigator.Name: Navigator

Arch Line.Description: Launch a tethered hook that either pulls enemies close, or pulls the Warframe toward any stationary objects it hooks onto.
Arch Line.Name: Arch Line

Guard Mode.Description: Take a stationary stance to deploy maximum firepower and gain increased structural integrity for a time.
Guard Mode.Name: Guard Mode

Sow.Description: Plant a death seed in nearby targets to drain their lifeforce. Reap what has been sown to detonate afflicted enemies, dealing a percentage of their health as radial damage. The souls of the dead fill the Death Well.
Sow.Name: Sow

Sol Gate.Description: Open a portal to the sun to irradiate enemies with a devastating beam of pure solar plasma. Hold fire to double Damage at the cost of increased energy consumption. For the duration of an attack enemies damaged by Sol Gate are increasingly more vulnerable to it.
Sol Gate.Name: Sol Gate

Smoke Screen.Description: Drops a smoke bomb that stuns enemies and obscures their vision, rendering Ash invisible for a short time.
Smoke Screen.Name: Smoke Screen

Smoke Screen (Stalker).Description: Cast a shadow that stuns enemies and obscures their vision, briefly making Stalker invisible.
Smoke Screen (Stalker).Name: Smoke Screen (Stalker)

Wormhole.Description: Creates a wormhole allowing instantaneous travel. Hold the ability to visualize placement.
Wormhole.Name: Wormhole

Sleight of Hand.Description: Booby trap nearby objects while conjuring an irresistible jewel that bursts with radial blind when touched in darkness, or a radial explosion in light. Conjure multiple smaller jewels with the help of Hall of Mirrors.
Sleight of Hand.Name: Sleight of Hand

Ophidian Bite.Description:
Lash out with a toxic serpentine strike, consuming the target to heal Lavos.

Hold to imbue all abilities with <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin.
Ophidian Bite.Name: Ophidian Bite

Energy Shell.Description: Forms a protective energy shell around the Warframe
Energy Shell.Name: Energy Shell

Silence.Description: Using Silence surrounds Banshee in an aura that stuns enemies and will limit their perceptions and tactical response to gunfire and Warframe attacks.
Silence.Name: Silence

Sickening Pulse.Description: Emit a pulse that adds stacks to Status Effects already afflicting enemies. The damage of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash, <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat, and <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin effects, excluding those created by Sickening Pulse itself, are added together to create a new instance of the Effect with a refreshed timer
Sickening Pulse.Name: Sickening Pulse

Remedium.Description: Uriel heals himself and his demons. If his demons are dead, they are resurrected.
Remedium.Name: Remedium

Shooting Gallery.Description: Gives an ally Extra Damage while jamming the guns of nearby enemies. This power shifts between team members.
Shooting Gallery.Name: Shooting Gallery

Containment Wall.Description: Contain the threat. Qorvex summons walls that slam together, damaging all enemies caught between them and inflicting <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status.
Containment Wall.Name: Containment Wall

Restorative (Duviri).Description: Cast to restore 100 Health to Drifter and clear Status Effects.
Restorative (Duviri).Name: Restorative

Shock.Description: Launch a voltaic projectile that stuns and damages its target. A chain of electricity extends from the target to shock nearby enemies.
Shock.Name: Shock

Lull.Description: A calming wave slows enemies until they fall into a slumber. Enemies woken by damage will be confused and disoriented. Short-term amnesia means all waking enemies forget anything that happened before the lull.
Lull.Name: Lull

Riptide.Description: Drag enemies into a crushing maelstrom and then blow them away in a watery burst. Each enemy trapped in the vortex increases the burst's damage.
Riptide.Name: Riptide

Symphony of Mercy.Description: Cycle through three songs that strengthen allies. Power of The Seven increases Ability Strength. Deathbringer increases Weapon Damage. Spirit of Resilience increases Shield Effectiveness. Extend the duration of each song by killing enemies surrounded by Judgments.
Symphony of Mercy.Name: Symphony of Mercy

Landslide.Description: Bash enemies with an explosive sliding punch, repeat up to three times for a combo attack. Each hit in the three-punch combo increases the radius of the attack. Energy cost is reduced with each hit of Landslide. Install mods on the Landslide Fists to boost stats.
Landslide.Name: Landslide

Crystallize.Description: Citrine summons crystal fractals. The fractals rush forward, seeking enemies. Enemies touched by the fractals are paralyzed by crystalline growths. Hit the growths to deal Critical Damage.
Crystallize.Name: Crystallize

Shadowgraph.Description:
Bring shadowgraphs from Follie's sketchbook to life as items that can be used for tactical advantage. Shadowgraphs splash Inkblot onto nearby enemies when created.

HOLD to open the Shadowgraph gear wheel.
Shadowgraph.Name: Shadowgraph

Seeking Fire.Description: Fires a large volley of homing missiles.
Seeking Fire.Name: Seeking Fire

Seek.Description: Plant an antenna that projects a forward wave scan. Detected enemies take increased Weak Point Damage, and become visible through walls. Weapons gain Punch through.
Seek.Name: Seek

Invisibility.Description: Loki camouflages himself, becoming invisible to enemies.
Invisibility.Name: Invisibility

Tharros Strike.Description: Summon Tharros, the shield of Styanax. Swing Tharros to repel enemies and reduce their shields and armor. Styanax regenerates health for every enemy struck.
Tharros Strike.Name: Tharros Strike

Sandstorm.Description: Become a sandstorm. Inaros devours enemies pulled into his whirlwind, healing himself.
Sandstorm.Name: Sandstorm

Lethal Progeny.Description: Cycle through Sentient unit types, then summon them to Caliban's side. Conculysts focus on raw melee damage. Ortholysts specialize in ranged attacks and inflict <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau Status Effect. Summulysts summon their own Choralysts and provide shield protection for the squad.
Lethal Progeny.Name: Lethal Progeny

Atomi-Shadow.Description: Jump off the Atmonicycle and become invisible for a brief period.
Atomi-Shadow.Name: Atomi-Shadow

Ravenous.Description: Gluttonous maggots swarm nearby enemies, feasting until they are hit with Virulence and burst with Infestation. The maggots benefit from Mutation and each enemy hit adds to the Mutation stack.
Ravenous.Name: Ravenous

Rotorswell.Description: Gyre's mechanisms spin at incredible speeds, generating an Electric Field that shocks nearby enemies. When Gyre gets a critical hit, a large electrical discharge will chain from the enemy that was hit to nearby enemies.
Rotorswell.Name: Rotorswell

Pacify & Provoke.Description: In Night-Form, reduces damage inflicted by nearby enemies. In Day-Form, increases Ability Strength of nearby allies.
Pacify & Provoke.Name: Pacify & Provoke

Event Horizon.Description:
Orion forms a drifting black hole, trapping enemies within its gravity. Hitting the black hole with Gravitic Slash or Coronal Ejection will extend its duration and change its trajectory: Gravitic Slash will direct it away from Orion, and Coronal Ejection will pull it towards Sirius.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Light's Sanctuary.
Event Horizon.Name: Event Horizon

Metronome.Description: Grants buffs to those who consistently perform actions in time to Octavia's music. Timed jumps offer the Vivace speed buff. Crouching on the beat grants cloaking with the Nocturne buff. Firing rhythmically bestows Opera multishot buff. Timed melee swings give the Forte damage buff.
Metronome.Name: Metronome

Chaos.Description: Nyx releases a devastating psychic pulse, disorienting enemies in a wide radius and forcing them to turn on each other. Confused foes lash out at random factions.
Chaos.Name: Chaos

Consume.Description: Dash through enemies and rip out their souls to heal Shadow.
Consume.Name: Consume

Ripper's Wail.Description:
Rip on the guitar to make Temple briefly invulnerable while healing them. Ally's weapons in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range are lit-up with extra <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage each time an ability is used on the Backbeat and successfully hits enemies.

Backbeat Timing: Invulnerability lasts longer.
Ripper's Wail.Name: Ripper's Wail

Rhino Stomp.Description: Rhino stomps with force sufficient to disrupt time, tumbling enemies around him in stasis.
Rhino Stomp.Name: Rhino Stomp

Toxic Lash.Description: While active, attacks deal additional <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage; this effect is doubled for Melee Strikes. Instantly burst spores when attacking afflicted enemies.
Toxic Lash.Name: Toxic Lash

Shadows of the Dead.Description: Summon shadow versions of vanquished enemies to fight alongside you for a short period.
Shadows of the Dead.Name: Shadows of the Dead

Razorwing.Description: Shrink down and take flight, while razorflies attack nearby enemies and amplify the damage they take.
Razorwing.Name: Razorwing

Ice Wave.Description: Sends a wave of razor sharp, crystalized ice toward an enemy, dealing heavy damage.
Ice Wave.Name: Ice Wave

Gloom.Description: Summon a radial pulse wave that ensnares and slows enemies, siphoning their lifeforce for the Death Well. Allies within the wave steal health with each attack.
Gloom.Name: Gloom

Radial Javelin.Description: Radial javelins impale nearby enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
Radial Javelin.Name: Radial Javelin

Radial Blind.Description: Emit a bright flash of light, blinding all nearby enemies.
Radial Blind.Name: Radial Blind

Fangs of Raksh.Description:
(TAP) Raksh's fangs tear into your enemies. 5 random Status Effects are applied at 10 Stacks each on an enemy. On target's death, spread the Status Effects to other nearby enemies.

(HOLD) Raksh guards Voruna with Status Effect resistance.
Fangs of Raksh.Name: Fangs of Raksh

Banish.Description: Casts a wave of Rift energy that damages hostiles while pushing enemies and allies out of Limbo's current plane of existence.
Banish.Name: Banish

Pyrotechnics.Description:
Blast targeted enemies with pillars of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage. 

Backbeat Timing: Ignite even more pillars. Increases the Duration and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage of Ripper's Wail when it deals damage.
Pyrotechnics.Name: Pyrotechnics

Spectral Scream.Description: Exhale a deep breath of elemental destruction. Tap to cycle through elements, hold to cast. The chosen element applies to all of Chroma's abilities.
Spectral Scream.Name: Spectral Scream

Bloomer.Description: Fires a high-yield, remotely detonated explosive projectile capable of latching onto targets.
Bloomer.Name: Bloomer

Polarize.Description: Emit an energy pulse that depletes enemy shields and armor as it restores ally shields. Debris left over from the pulse becomes Polarize Shards. Nearby Polarize Shards orbit Mag and cut enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effect.
Polarize.Name: Polarize

Smite.Description: Focuses deadly energy within a target, dealing massive damage and removing all of its defenses, including Overguard. Enemies near the target also take a portion of the damage.
Smite.Name: Smite

Parasitic Armor.Description: Sacrifice Shields to reinforce Armor for a period of time.
Parasitic Armor.Name: Parasitic Armor

Slash Dash.Description: Slash and dash through enemies alongside a radial specter. The powerful Exalted Blade's slashes inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
Slash Dash.Name: Slash Dash

Hideous Resistance.Description: Grant yourself immunity to Status effects.
Hideous Resistance.Name: Hideous Resistance

Airburst.Description: Launch a burst of massively dense air. Hold to send enemies flying, tap to pull them toward the burst. Damage increases per enemy hit.
Airburst.Name: Airburst

Forced Perspective.Description: Drop through an inky frame and emerge invulnerable at the aimed location in a splash of ink that inflicts Inkblot on nearby enemies.
Forced Perspective.Name: Forced Perspective

Omikuji.Description:
Koumei glimpses a favorable future and the precise steps needed to reach it. Complete the challenge to earn a Decree. Unlucky rolls add a debuff, but you can hold the ability to reject the Omikuji.

A roll of triple sixes grants a Decree without a challenge.
Omikuji.Name: Omikuji

Null Star.Description: Creates antimatter particles that orbit Nova and attack nearby targets. Each active particle reduces damage to Nova's Health and Shields.
Null Star.Name: Null Star

Prism.Description: Fires an energy prism that shoots lasers in all directions. Activating again detonates the prism, blinding nearby foes.
Prism.Name: Prism

Warcry.Description: Valkyr lets out a rallying cry that bolsters Armor and Attack Speed for allies while in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range.
Warcry.Name: Warcry

Mesmer Skin.Description: Become enveloped in Sentient energy, redirecting damage and stunning all those who dare attack. Stunned enemies can be Enthralled at no energy cost.
Mesmer Skin.Name: Mesmer Skin

Mercy's Kiss.Description: Leap onto an enemy and pierce them with Oraxia's spider legs, dealing <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage. Enemies defeated by this attack have a chance to drop Health or Energy Orbs.
Mercy's Kiss.Name: Mercy's Kiss

Avalanche.Description: Summons a treacherous landslide of ice that instantly freezes and shatters all enemies in its radius.
Avalanche.Name: Avalanche

Roar.Description: Grants all nearby Warframes increased damage for a short duration.
Roar.Name: Roar

Marked.Description: Stun a target. When a target dies, a portion of damage dealt to the target is dealt to other nearby enemies.
Marked.Name: Marked

Ensnare.Description: Bind a hapless target in living metal, entangling others who stray too close. Whipclaw will refresh the trap allowing it to capture more enemies.
Ensnare.Name: Ensnare

Shield Maiden.Description: Raise Bonewidow's shield to block incoming forward damage, reflecting it back at attackers. While active, bash enemies with a Maiden's Kiss.
Shield Maiden.Name: Shield Maiden

Light Verse.Description: Dante's vitalizing composition grants him and his allies Overguard and restores their Health.
Light Verse.Name: Light Verse

Rumblers.Description: Summon two elemental stone brawlers to the melee. Summoning petrifies enemies in close proximity to Atlas. When finished, Rumblers collapse into a pile of healing Rubble.
Rumblers.Name: Rumblers

Larva.Description: Spawn an Infested pod that erupts with tendrils, latches onto nearby enemies and pulls them in. Enemies killed while held have a chance of generating a Mutation stack.
Larva.Name: Larva

Preserving Shell.Description: Citrine guards herself and nearby allies with a crystalline shell that gradually decays. Kills and assists increase the defensive power of the shell.
Preserving Shell.Name: Preserving Shell

Immolation.Description: Protect Ember with flame armor that burns stronger over time, consuming energy once its meter is at full strength. Cast again to extinguish the flame.
Immolation.Name: Immolation

Rakhali's Cavalry.Description: Phantom Kaithes charge forth, inflicting Viral Damage upon all in their path. Their attack strips the defenses of Doomed enemies.
Rakhali's Cavalry.Name: Rakhali's Cavalry

Fire Walker.Description: Blaze a trail of flames, scorching enemies and cleansing allies. Teleporting blasts the landing area with a ring of fire.
Fire Walker.Name: Fire Walker

Spores.Description: Inflict a target with a pox of <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive spores. Spread spores to nearby enemies by destroying them or killing their host. The longer the Spore spreads, its damage will increase.
Spores.Name: Spores

Fighter Escort.Description: Deploys drones that fight alongside the Warframe, each detonating in a destructive blast when killed.
Fighter Escort.Name: Fighter Escort

Evade.Description: Jump backwards and become invisible for a short duration. Killing enemies on their Weak Points extends the duration and heals Cyte-09.
Evade.Name: Evade

Exalted Blade.Description: Summon a sword of pure light and immense power.
Exalted Blade.Name: Exalted Blade

Energy Pulse.Description: Energy pickups grant '''20 / 30 / 40 / 50''' % additional energy over '''11 / 9 / 7 / 5'''s.
Energy Pulse.Name: Energy Pulse

Empower.Description: Increase the strength of your next ability use.
Empower.Name: Empower

The Lost.Description: Cycle through a trio of lost Warframe powers. Accuse manifests a Void fissure to corrupt enemies into allies. Gaze grasps targets in Void tendrils that capture damage and inflict it when the target is released. Deny annihilates with a beam of Void energy, wiping Sentient resistances.
The Lost.Name: The Lost

Condemn.Description: Cast a wave of energy that chains them where they stand. Each enemy held reinforces Harrow's shields.
Condemn.Name: Condemn

Doom.Description: Condemn nearby enemies to their doom. A portion of the damage Dagath deals is revisited upon them by a Wyrd Scythe. They also suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage.
Doom.Name: Doom

Electric Shield.Description:
Volt deploys an electric shield that blocks enemy fire and adds <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage to projectiles.
 
HOLD to equip the shield for mobile cover.
Electric Shield.Name: Electric Shield

Rest & Rage.Description: In Night-Form, targets are put to sleep. In Day-Form, targets become more vulnerable to damage.
Rest & Rage.Name: Rest & Rage

Master's Summons.Description: Heal your companion and call it to your side.
Master's Summons.Name: Master's Summons

Meathook.Description: Skewer and hold a target, siphoning their health. Use again to hurl the victim damaging them and anyone near the impact site.
Meathook.Name: Meathook
